title: We use cookies
description: Hospeda uses cookies to ensure the site works and, with your consent, to report errors and analyze how you use it. Necessary cookies are always active.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Cookies essential for the site to function: user session, consent state and dismissed announcements. These cannot be disabled.

crashReporting.label: Crash reporting
crashReporting.description: Sends errors that occur while you use the site to Sentry, together with recordings of a sample of sessions and of the sessions in which an error occurs, with all text hidden and no images. Lets us fix bugs that affect you. Recommended to keep enabled.

analytics.label: Usage analytics
analytics.description: Statistics about how the site is browsed (most-viewed pages, search flows), with Umami. If you are signed in, they may be linked to your account’s internal identifier, never to your email. When active, it may include session recordings and heatmaps with all text and fields masked; never on sign-in, your account, checkout, publishing listings or the contact page. Does not include error monitoring.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: We currently do not use marketing or advertising cookies. This field is reserved for future use.
